criterion: which banking customer-service intent the query expresses

categories.name: Card Management
categories.definition: Requests to order, activate, freeze, unfreeze, or report lost or stolen physical or virtual cards.

categories.name: Transaction Issues
categories.definition: Reports of unauthorized, duplicate, or unrecognized transactions, or disputes regarding transaction amounts and missing refunds.

categories.name: Transfers and Deposits
categories.definition: Queries regarding the status, failure, cancellation, or non-arrival of sent or received money transfers and deposits.

categories.name: Fees and Exchange Rates
categories.definition: Questions or disputes about fees for transfers, withdrawals, card usage, currency exchange rates, and other service charges.

categories.name: Identity Verification
categories.definition: Issues or questions regarding the process of verifying identity, source of funds, or account access restrictions due to verification status.

categories.name: Top Up
categories.definition: Queries about methods, limits, fees, or failures related to adding funds to the account balance.

categories.name: ATM and Cash Withdrawal
categories.definition: Issues specifically related to using ATMs, including cash withdrawal failures, captured cards, and locating machines.

categories.name: Account Management
categories.definition: Requests to close or delete an account, update personal details, or questions regarding account eligibility and login access.

categories.name: Card Functionality
categories.definition: Reports of cards being declined, failing to work for payments, or issues with specific features like contactless payments.

categories.name: PIN Management
categories.definition: Requests to change, reset, unblock, or locate a PIN, or issues regarding PIN entry attempts.

categories.name: General Information
categories.definition: General questions about card types, supported currencies, delivery times, usage locations, and operational procedures.
